name: Flutter
description: Cross-platform UI toolkit for iOS, Android, web, and desktop.
why: A mature choice for a single codebase across mobile platforms.

name: Dart
description: The language and toolchain behind Flutter.
why: Needed for sound null safety and idiomatic Flutter code.

name: Expo
description: React Native toolchain with builds, updates, and native module access.
why: The fastest path to a production React Native app.

name: React Native
description: Build native mobile apps with React.
why: Lets a React team ship mobile without a second UI paradigm.

name: Jetpack Compose
description: Android's declarative UI toolkit in Kotlin.
why: The current default for new Android UI.

name: SwiftUI
description: Apple's declarative UI framework across its platforms.
why: The native path for iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, and visionOS.

name: Kotlin
description: Concise JVM language with first-class Android support.
why: The language for modern Android and Compose work.

name: Swift
description: Apple's language for iOS, macOS, and server-side Swift.
why: Required for native Apple platform development.
